verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an LLMs.txt file that provides a structured index of the portal's public content, and a probe confirmed it is live (HTTP 200 at docs.asaas.com/llms.txt). It also documents a docs MCP endpoint so assistants can query the documentation and API reference. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, plus evidence of the llms.txt content's depth or completeness (e.g., a full-text llms-full.txt variant).
